definition: Cab controls that request passenger-door opening or closing subject to the vehicle’s operating conditions.
An indication that the monitored passenger-door system has confirmed the required door-closed condition.
A system condition that restricts traction or another action until required passenger-door status is confirmed.
The period during which passenger doors are moving toward their fully open state.
The period during which passenger doors are moving toward their secured closed state.
Information showing the current condition or transition of the passenger-door system.
